summary: Bilibili (HKEX: 9626) announced completion, after Hong Kong trading hours on November 5, 2026, of a concurrent transaction with Tencent: a US$200 million aggregate principal subscription by a Tencent subsidiary for newly issued convertible Notes, paired with Bilibili's repurchase of US$200 million of its existing Class Z ordinary shares and ADSs held by Tencent subsidiaries. The deal follows the September 4, 2026 announcement, September 25 circular and October 28, 2026 poll-results announcement. Repurchased shares are cancelled, triggering a Rule 8A.15 weighted-voting-rights adjustment. Watch conversion price, Tencent's residual stake and overhang, and post-closing ownership/voting splits.
